gallery.title: File:150915-F-WE773-332 (21704524465).jpg
gallery.description: Airman 1st Class Thomas Smith, assigned to the 374th Civil Engineer Squadron fire protection, shovels mud from an irrigation system in Kanuma City, Tochigi Prefecture, Japan, Sept. 15, 2015, after floodwaters hit the city. Smith and other members of a large volunteer force from Yokota Air Base ventured to Tochigi to assist locals with mud removal, sand bagging and fixing what was broken during a recent flood and landslide. (U.S. Air Force photo/Staff Sgt. Cody H. Ramirez)

gallery.title: File:150804-F-WH816-162 (20187704179).jpg
gallery.description: Staff Sgt. Trevor Alexis, a 374th Civil Engineer Squadron fire protection NCO in charge of training, waits to enter a flashover trainer Aug. 4, 2015, at Yokota Air Base, Japan. Flashover, a near-simultaneous ignition of many objects in a confined room, creates a dangerous situation where both heat and smoke continue to increase until combustion. Simulating a flashover fire in a confined room with limited ventilation, enables a trainer to educate and prepare firefighters to recognize and react to a potentially dangerous situation. (U.S. Air Force photo/Airman 1st Class Delano Scott)

gallery.title: File:150920-F-WE773-024 (21815799055).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: Staff Sgt. Brian Wright, 1st Battalion, 1st Special Operations Group (Airborne), holds a U.S. flag outside a C-130 Hercules during the 2015 Japanese-American Friendship Festival at Yokota Air Base, Japan, Sept. 20, 2015. The U.S. flag, waved by Wright, was held out one C-130 and a Japanese flag was simultaneously held outside another taxing aircraft, symbolizing the US and Japan partnership and reinforcing the general idea of the festival--to increase bilateral relationships between the two countries. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Cody H. Ramirez/Released)

gallery.title: File:150825-F-PM645-173 (21031817046).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. Nicholas Poe, 459th Airlift Squadron flight engineer, right, loads Combat Assault Battalion Marines with the 3rd Marine Division during Exercise Iron Fist at Combined Arms Training Center Camp Fuji, Aug. 25, 2015. The UH-1N crew members participated in the joint exercise, providing an air asset for casualty evacuation and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance. The 459 AS regularly provides airlift capabilities in support of regional contingencies. (U.S. Air Force photo by Osakabe Yasuo/Released)

gallery.title: File:140113-F-PM645-009 (11981794416).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: A U.S. Air Force C-130 Hercules aircraft transporting Airmen returning from a deployment to Southwest Asia flies over Yokota Air Base, Japan, Jan. 13, 2014. (DoD photo by Yasuo Osakabe, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:131022-F-PM645-398 (10457090884).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Capt. Chance Hansen, a C-130 Hercules aircraft pilot with the 36th Airlift Squadron, visually locates another C-130 over Japan Oct. 22, 2013, during a large-formation flight. (DoD photo by Yasuo Osakabe, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:131008-F-SI013-352 (10309891113).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Capt. Mike Kelly, a co-pilot with the 36th Airlift Squadron, flies a C-130 Hercules aircraft during a training mission as part of readiness week at Yokota Air Base, Japan, Oct. 8, 2013. Yokota's airlifters provided rapid tactical airlift support throughout the pacific theater. (DoD photo by Captain Raymond Geoffroy, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:131008-F-PM645-010 (10194354625).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: From left, U.S. Air Force Airman 1st Class Andrew Fox and Tech. Sgt. Todd Bergin, both loadmasters with the 36th Airlift Squadron, secure safety harnesses before deploying a low-cost, low-altitude payload over Yokota Air Base, Japan, as part of a training mission during Readiness Week Oct. 8, 2013. The week-long event was designed to prepare Airmen for airlift missions in support of contingency operations in the Pacific. (DoD photo by Yasuo Osakabe, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. (DoD photo by Osakabe Yasuo, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:130221-F-WE773-483 (8506779177).jpg

gallery.description: Six U.S. Air Force C-130 Hercules aircraft assigned to the 374th Airlift Wing line up before flying during a readiness week Feb. 21, 2013, at Yokota Air Base, Japan. (DoD photo by Senior Airman Cody H. Ramirez, U.S. Air Force/Released)

gallery.title: File:120119-F-NW635-040 (6755892189).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Navy Cmdr. Tim Curry, the deputy director of operations with U.S. Forces Japan, talks about the upcoming exercise Keen Edge 2012 with reporters at the Bilateral Joint Operations Coordination Center, Yokota Air Base, Japan, Jan. 19, 2012. Keen Edge (KE) is a joint/bilateral command post exercise involving U.S. military and Japan Self Defense Forces (JSDF) personnel. KE is held every other year and alternates years with the Keen Sword field exercise. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Samuel Morse/Released)

gallery.description: Yokota residents attend a Christmas tree lighting ceremony Nov. 30, 2011, at the traditional chapel at Yokota Air Base, Japan. The event kicked off the holiday season. (U.S. Air Force photo by Yasuo Osakabe/Released)

gallery.title: File:110321-F-UI176-149 (5568298525).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Department of Defense Current Photos
gallery.description: U.S. Air Force Senior Airman Daniel Burdick, right, with the 18th Aerospace Medicine Squadron, scans Staff Sgt. Aaron Wermy, assigned to the 374th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron, with a radiation meter at Yokota Air Base in Japan March 21, 2011.  Burdick is a member of a contamination avoidance team designed to check aircraft, vehicles and personnel for radiation exposure after missions. (DoD photo by Staff Sgt. Jonathan Steffen, U.S. Air Force/Released)
